name: GNK ASG All Desk
purpose: Unified contact, mail, WhatsApp, publication and intelligence intake framework for GNK ASG d.o.o.

public_positioning.hr: GNK ASG All Desk je planirani okvir za strukturiranje službene komunikacije, kontakt forme, e-mail kanala, WhatsApp upita, medijskih zahtjeva i GNK ASG Intelligence Desk procesa.
public_positioning.en: GNK ASG All Desk is the planned framework for structuring official communication, contact forms, email channels, WhatsApp inquiries, media requests and GNK ASG Intelligence Desk workflows.

security_rules: The public portal must not request or store email passwords.
Authentication must be handled through the official mail provider or approved backend integrations.
Sensitive legal, financial, medical, personal-data, banking or contractual matters require manual review.
Payment instructions and bank-account changes must never be automated without human verification.
Public AI explanations must remain grounded in published portal content and public sources.

implementation_phases.name: Public contact and routing layer
implementation_phases.description: Contact pages, contact channel configuration, mailto routing and WhatsApp message preparation.

implementation_phases.name: Zoho Mail activation
implementation_phases.description: Domain verification, MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC configuration inside DNS.

implementation_phases.name: Mailbox classification and draft responses
implementation_phases.description: Incoming messages are classified and draft responses are prepared according to category and sensitivity.

implementation_phases.name: Calendar, reminders and open-item tracking
implementation_phases.description: Meeting requests, deadlines and unanswered items are connected to reminders and calendar workflow.

implementation_phases.name: Publication and social distribution workflow
implementation_phases.description: GNK ASG Intelligence Desk publications, SEO metadata, sitemap, LinkedIn and Facebook post preparation.
